requirements.shall: A stream SHALL carry elements of exactly one runtime type declared at construction; `bool` SHALL NOT satisfy a non-`bool` numeric type.
A write of a mistyped element SHALL raise `ElementTypeMismatch` (`PK_STREAM_TYPE_MISMATCH`) and SHALL NOT consume credit or buffer.
A writer SHALL NOT enqueue without reader-granted credit; a creditless write SHALL raise `CreditExhausted` and increment `credit_stalls`.
`grant(n)` SHALL accept only positive `int` (not `bool`) and SHALL raise `CreditLimitExceeded` if outstanding credit would exceed `StreamConfig.max_credit`, leaving credit unchanged.
The in-flight buffer SHALL never exceed `StreamConfig.max_buffer`; a write at the ceiling SHALL raise `BufferLimitExceeded` without consuming credit.
`StreamConfig` fields SHALL be positive integers; invalid values SHALL raise `ValueError` at construction.
Graceful end-of-stream SHALL be explicit (`end()`); `read()` SHALL return `None` only after `end()` and after the buffer is drained.
`read()` SHALL return `NOT_READY` (not `None`) when the writer is live and the buffer is empty.
Dropping the reader SHALL discard buffered elements, count them in `dropped_items`, zero credit, and make every subsequent operation except `drop_*` raise `EndDropped(end="reader")`.
Dropping the writer SHALL keep buffered elements drainable; once drained, `read()` SHALL raise `EndDropped(end="writer")` (distinguishable from graceful EOF).
Interface versions SHALL be negotiated to the highest mutually supported integer; with no overlap the open SHALL be refused with `VersionUnsupported` (never guessed).
Per-tenant stream count and buffered elements SHALL be bounded by `TenantQuota`; excess SHALL raise `QuotaExceeded`.

Shared credit pools SHALL be allocated by weighted deficit round-robin such that every tenant with demand receives a share while the pool lasts; the registry applies this via `rebalance(pool)` with weights from `TenantQuota.weight`.
All state mutations on a stream SHALL be serialized by a per-stream `RLock`; `stats()` SHALL return a consistent snapshot.
Bounded waits SHALL honour a timeout (`StreamTimeout`) and a `CancelToken` (`StreamCancelled`); a timeout SHALL NOT imply end-of-stream.
A write retried with an `idempotency_key` already accepted within `idempotency_window` SHALL return `False`, consume no credit and enqueue nothing.
Every error SHALL carry a stable machine code and details via `StreamError.as_dict()`.
A frozen stream SHALL refuse `grant` and `write` with `StreamFrozen`; buffered elements SHALL remain readable.
